clawscan_note: Runs local ffmpeg/OpenCV to cut and render user-supplied screen recordings. Optionally drives a headless browser (Playwright) or a local GUI app to capture demo footage, and writes outputs into ~/Movies/demo-videos. No network calls at runtime beyond those optional recorders.
pr_description: Product demo video maker: give it a screen recording and it detects active segments, stitches multiple takes in story order, cuts dead air and loading screens, zooms + ripples key clicks, mosaics sensitive info, and burns in frame-accurate captions (plus an editable .srt and a clean no-caption version). Also supports headless web capture, screenshot sets, and AI-driven Mac app recording as material sources.
